headline: Approved contract amendment, fund transfer, RAN renewal, and two new CJC positions, all unanimously
summary: The Board approved the consent agenda including minutes and a childcare lease at Robert Miller Community Center. It also approved an amended contract with Jones Payne Group for the Airport's Residential Sound Insulation Program, a $500,000 fund transfer from the Traffic Fund to the Parking Facilities Fund, a renewal of a revenue anticipation note up to $2.5 Million, and the creation of two new positions within the Community Justice Center.
decisions: Approved and recommended the lease of childcare space at the Robert Miller Community Center with The Greater Burlington YMCA
Approved and recommended a contract with Jones Payne Group Inc. for up to $1,833,521.00 for construction oversight services for the Airport's Residential Sound Insulation Program
Approved and recommended transferring $500,000 from the Traffic Fund (264) to the Parking Facilities Fund (265) and a $820,284 principal-only payment towards the Revenue Anticipation Note
Approved and recommended adoption of a resolution renewing a revenue anticipation note for the Parking Facilities Fund, not to exceed $2.5Million at an interest rate not to exceed 7.5%
Approved and recommended creation of two new positions within the Community Justice Center
